citation.authors: Franbourg A, Hallegot P, Baltenneck F, Toutain C et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.population: Hair from Caucasian, Asian and African subjects (laboratory)
record.design: Structure, geometry, water swelling and tensile testing of hair fibres
record.finding: No differences in the intimate structure of the fibres were observed among the three hair types, whereas geometry, mechanical properties and water swelling differed by ethnic origin.
